Amritsar tours and sightseeing

Amritsar tours around the Golden Temple, the Jallianwala Bagh memorial and the evening ceremony at the Wagah border.

Why Amritsar

The Golden Temple is open to everyone, serves a free meal to anyone who sits down, and feeds roughly a hundred thousand people a day from a kitchen run almost entirely by volunteers.

Jallianwala Bagh is a five-minute walk away, and the contrast between the two is the point of a day here.

Questions people ask about Amritsar

Can anyone enter the Golden Temple?
Yes, regardless of faith. Heads must be covered, shoes left outside, and the pool walked around clockwise. Scarves are provided at the entrance.
Should we eat at the langar?
If you are comfortable sitting on the floor with everyone else, yes. It is the most quietly impressive thing in the city.
Is the Wagah border ceremony worth it?
It is loud, nationalistic and genuinely unusual. Go early — the stands fill well before it starts.
How long do we need?
One full day covers the temple, Jallianwala Bagh and Wagah. Two days adds the Partition Museum.
